title: centaurea regia subsp. cynarocephala
intro: Centaurea regia subsp. cynarocephala, commonly known as Mountain Cornflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in soothing digestive issues and alleviating symptoms of allergies. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea regia subsp. cynarocephala include its potential to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic agent, making it useful in treating infections, wounds, and menstrual cramps. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
